title: EXAMINING THE ROBUSTNESS OF HOMOGENEITY BIAS TO HYPERPARAMETER ADJUSTMENTS IN GPT-4

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring racial homogeneity bias by prompting a vision-language model to write stories based on images of Black and White individuals, encoding the generated stories into sentence embeddings, and calculating pairwise cosine similarities to assess how homogeneous the model's representations are for each racial group across different hyperparameter settings.

Measuring gender homogeneity bias by prompting a vision-language model to write stories based on images of men and women, encoding the generated stories into sentence embeddings, and calculating pairwise cosine similarities to assess how homogeneous the model's representations are for each gender group across different hyperparameter settings.
